query: INSERT INTO languages (id, name, version, source_file, compile_cmd, run_cmd, env, is_archived, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, version = EXCLUDED.version, source_file = EXCLUDED.source_file, compile_cmd = EXCLUDED.compile_cmd, run_cmd = EXCLUDED.run_cmd, env = EXCLUDED.env, is_archived = EXCLUDED.is_archived, updated_at = NOW()
